label: Open Project File
args: $(d="$ZED_FILE"; while [[ "$d" != "/" ]]; do c=$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.csproj" -print -quit 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$c" ]] && echo "$c" && break; d=$(dirname "$d"); done)

label: Build Project
command: dotnet build $(d="$ZED_FILE"; while [[ "$d" != "/" ]]; do c=$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.csproj" -print -quit 2>/dev/null); [[ -n "$c" ]] && echo "$c" && break; d=$(dirname "$d"); done)

label: Run Project
args: $(d="$ZED_FILE"; while [[ $d != / ]]; do c=$(find $d -maxdepth 1 -name '*.csproj' -print -quit 2>/dev/null); [[ -n $c ]] && echo $c && break; d=$(dirname $d); done)

label: Run All Tests in Root Directory
Test Project
args: $(d="$ZED_FILE"; while [[ $d != / ]]; do c=$(find $d -maxdepth 1 -name '*.csproj' -print -quit 2>/dev/null); [[ -n $c ]] && echo $c && break; d=$(dirname $d); done)

label: Run: ${ZED_CUSTOM_csharp_method_name}
command: p=""; d=$(dirname "$DOTNET_FILE"); while [[ -z "$p" && "$d" != "/" ]]; do p=$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.csproj" -print -quit 2>/dev/null); d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if grep -qs "TUnit" "$p"; then dotnet run --project "$p" -- --treenode-filter "/*/*/$CSHARP_TEST_CLASS/$CSHARP_TEST_METHOD"; else dotnet test "$p" --filter "FullyQualifiedName~$CSHARP_TEST_CLASS.$CSHARP_TEST_METHOD"; fi

label: Run: ${ZED_CUSTOM_csharp_class_name}
command: p=""; d=$(dirname "$DOTNET_FILE"); while [[ -z "$p" && "$d" != "/" ]]; do p=$(find "$d" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.csproj" -print -quit 2>/dev/null); d=$(dirname "$d"); done; if grep -qs "TUnit" "$p"; then dotnet run --project "$p" -- --treenode-filter "/*/*/$CSHARP_TEST_CLASS/*"; else dotnet test "$p" --filter "FullyQualifiedName~$CSHARP_TEST_CLASS"; fi
